alternative_explanations: Contextual Chow-Liu is itself a tractable conditional circuit and may recover exactly the same decomposition with less structure-learning overhead, eliminating any distinct SPN advantage.
Any apparent query benefit may be compilation amortization that disappears once raw-sample reading, selector search, circuit state and local rebuilding are charged.
confounds: The generator is exactly representable by a tiny two-context pair circuit, uses complete synthetic samples at K=8/32, and cannot establish open-world generality, asymptotic scaling or an LLM successor.
falsification_criteria: Discard the learned route if learned_decomposable_spn has accuracy or near-equivalent accuracy below 0.95 in any cell, is miscalibrated, loses unrelated-context retention, grows superlinearly in circuit nodes over K=8/32 without compensating capability, or is matched in capability with equal-or-lower fit/state/update/R16 cost by contextual_chow_liu or pairwise_factor_elimination.

outcome_policy.negative: If learned structure misses conditionals, calibration or retention, or requires unfavorable circuit growth, discard this implementation and return HYP-0013 to dormant while preserving all failures.
outcome_policy.null: If contextual Chow-Liu or generic pairwise elimination matches capability with equal-or-lower full workload, retain probabilistic compilation only as established classical structure and return HYP-0013 to dormant without tuning this cohort.
outcome_policy.positive: Retain HYP-0013 as testing and permit one adversarial screen only if the preregistered learned-SPN capability, calibration, retention and implementable Pareto gates all pass.

predicted_outcome: Uniform and single-tree controls should miss hidden-selector conditionals; empirical tables should pay high state or sparse-coverage error; contextual Chow-Liu, pairwise elimination and learned decomposable SPN should recover the two context-specific matchings. The learned SPN is expected to match rather than dominate contextual Chow-Liu after structure search, circuit size, local update and R16 accounting; oracle is a separate lower bound.
promotion_criteria: Quick cannot promote. Permit one adversarial multi-seed screen only if learned_decomposable_spn is at least 0.95 accurate in every cell, calibrated on hidden-selector near queries, retains the unrelated context after update, and lies on the implementable full-system Pareto frontier against contextual Chow-Liu and pairwise elimination.
research_question: Can a learned smooth decomposable circuit recover context-specific independence from raw samples and answer unseen conditional queries with a better capability-cost-update tradeoff than contextual Chow-Liu and generic factor elimination?
title: Learned context-specific probabilistic circuit compilation
